key_insight: HSE made exact exchange practical in extended materials by retaining it at short range, delivering substantially improved band gaps without fitting its exchange fraction to solids.
engineering_relevance: More reliable band-gap calculations support semiconductor screening for photovoltaics, defect engineering, power electronics, and quantum technologies.
method: Combine short-range exact exchange with semilocal exchange, screening out long-range exact exchange.
Trace HSE’s origins and the HSE03-to-HSE06 revision.
Compare recent semilocal and hybrid functionals across accuracy, cost, and transferability.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved gaps for ordinary semiconductors and selected metal oxides, and benchmark comparisons showing HSE06-level accuracy from recent meta-GGAs for selected semiconductors.
watch_item: Fixed screening limits adaptability across materials; this perspective is not an AI study or a demonstration of solar-cell device performance.
paper_title: Perspective: The HSE Screened Hybrid and the Band Gap Problem: Origins, Impact, and the Contenders
